<?php
/**
 * Multi-tenant Database Driver with CSRF Protection
 * Handles tenant isolation and request validation for database operations
 */

class TenantDatabaseDriver {
    private $pdo;
    private $tenantId;
    private $csrfTokenStore;
    private $requestContext;

    public function __construct(PDO $pdo, string $tenantId) {
        $this->pdo = $pdo;
        $this->tenantId = $tenantId;
        $this->csrfTokenStore = new CsrfTokenStore();
        $this->requestContext = new RequestContext();
    }

    /**
     * Validates the CSRF token for state-changing operations
     */
    public function validateCsrfToken(string $token, string $sessionId): bool {
        $storedToken = $this->csrfTokenStore->getToken($sessionId);
        if ($storedToken === null) {
            return false;
        }
        return hash_equals($storedToken, $token);
    }

    /**
     * Determines if the current request requires CSRF validation
     * based on the operation type and request origin
     */
    private function requiresCsrfValidation(string $operation): bool {
        $readOperations = ['SELECT', 'DESCRIBE', 'SHOW', 'EXPLAIN'];
        $upperOp = strtoupper(trim($operation));
        
        foreach ($readOperations as $readOp) {
            if (strpos($upperOp, $readOp) === 0) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        // State-changing operations always require CSRF token validation
        // regardless of origin or referer headers
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Check if origin matches trusted domains (used for logging only)
     */
    private function isOriginTrusted(?string $origin, array $trustedDomains): bool {
        if ($origin === null) {
            return false;
        }
        $parsedOrigin = parse_url($origin, PHP_URL_HOST);
        foreach ($trustedDomains as $domain) {
            if ($this->domainMatches($parsedOrigin, $domain)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Domain matching with subdomain support
     */
    private function domainMatches(?string $hostname, string $trustedDomain): bool {
        if ($hostname === null) {
            return false;
        }
        // Allow exact match or subdomain match
        if ($hostname === $trustedDomain) {
            return true;
        }
        // Check if hostname ends with .trustedDomain
        $suffix = '.' . $trustedDomain;
        return substr($hostname, -strlen($suffix)) === $suffix;
    }

    /**
     * Check if referer matches trusted domains (used for logging only)
     */
    private function isRefererTrusted(?string $referer, array $trustedDomains): bool {
        if ($referer === null) {
            return false;
        }
        $parsedHost = parse_url($referer, PHP_URL_HOST);
        foreach ($trustedDomains as $domain) {
            if ($this->domainMatches($parsedHost, $domain)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Get trusted domains for this tenant
     */
    private function getTrustedDomains(): array {
        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare(
            'SELECT domain FROM tenant_trusted_domains WHERE tenant_id = :tid'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':tid' => $this->tenantId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
    }

    /**
     * Execute a database query with tenant isolation and CSRF protection
     */
    public function executeQuery(string $sql, array $params, string $sessionId, ?string $csrfToken): array {
        // Enforce tenant isolation by prepending tenant filter
        $isolatedSql = $this->applyTenantIsolation($sql);

        // Check if CSRF validation is needed
        if ($this->requiresCsrfValidation($sql)) {
            if ($csrfToken === null || !$this->validateCsrfToken($csrfToken, $sessionId)) {
                throw new SecurityException('CSRF validation failed');
            }
        }

        // Log origin information for audit purposes
        $origin = $this->requestContext->getHeader('Origin');
        $trustedDomains = $this->getTrustedDomains();
        $isTrusted = $this->isOriginTrusted($origin, $trustedDomains);
        error_log(sprintf('Query from %s origin: %s', $isTrusted ? 'trusted' : 'untrusted', $origin ?? 'none'));

        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare($isolatedSql);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    }

    /**
     * Apply tenant isolation to queries
     */
    private function applyTenantIsolation(string $sql): string {
        // Add tenant_id condition to WHERE clause
        if (stripos($sql, 'WHERE') !== false) {
            $sql = preg_replace(
                '/WHERE/i',
                'WHERE tenant_id = ' . $this->pdo->quote($this->tenantId) . ' AND ',
                $sql,
                1
            );
        } else {
            $sql .= ' WHERE tenant_id = ' . $this->pdo->quote($this->tenantId);
        }
        return $sql;
    }
}

class CsrfTokenStore {
    public function getToken(string $sessionId): ?string {
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
            session_id($sessionId);
            session_start();
        }
        return $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? null;
    }

    public function generateToken(string $sessionId): string {
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
            session_id($sessionId);
            session_start();
            // Prevent session fixation: regenerate the session ID so that a
            // caller/attacker-supplied session ID cannot be used to bind a
            // known session to a freshly generated CSRF token.
            session_regenerate_id(true);
        }
        $token = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = $token;
        return $token;
    }
}

class RequestContext {
    public function getHeader(string $name): ?string {
        $serverKey = 'HTTP_' . strtoupper(str_replace('-', '_', $name));
        return $_SERVER[$serverKey] ?? null;
    }
}

class SecurityException extends \RuntimeException {}
